create_fasta_file: create a FASTA file from a biological sequence string with configurable line width
check_binary_exists: check if a binary executable exists at a given path and raise if missing
run_subprocess: run a subprocess command with logging, timing, and error handling for external tools
check_jackhmmer_seq_limit: check if a Jackhmmer binary supports the seq-limit flag before use
run_with_logging: run a subprocess command with optional stdout and stderr logging to absl logs
